note: The 1901 enumerator's walk along Clumber Road East, schedules 157 to 160, read from the page images supplied by A. Hagues. Schedule 158 (Samuel Bourne, Adam House) is already in the record and is not repeated here. The other three are filed as follows. 157 is CERTAIN: William Warner, his wife Elizabeth and their daughter Dorris Gwendolen are already in the record at Westwood in 1921 and 1939, and all three match on age, so they are bound here by id rather than created again. 160 is STRONG: Wright's Directory prints James Snook at Penrhyn House in 1910-11, nine years later. 159 is FORCED BY POSITION: taking the surveyed coordinates, the houses run out from the Tattershall end as St Helier, Westwood, Jelenice, Adam House, Edale House, Penrhyn House; with 157 at Westwood and 158 at Adam House the walk is heading north, and the only house between Adam House and Penrhyn House is Edale House. The walk skips Jelenice and St Helier and nobody yet knows why - see the research question 'clumber-road-east-1901-walk'. If that skip turns out to mean the order is not what it looks like, schedule 159 is the filing to revisit first.
